title: Price-Class Multiplier for Returned Footwear Box Fees
content:
Premium pairs and marked-down pairs carry different box fees. The Returns & Exchanges shoebox fee per unit on returned footwear is multiplied according to how the pair was sold on the Online Orders order.

| How the pair was sold | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Booked at a unit price of 150 USD or more | 1.5 |
| Sold at a clearance or flash-sale price, below 150 USD | 0.5 |
| Any other pair | Not multiplied |

The booked unit price and the price type (regular, clearance or flash sale) are read from the pair's booking line.

## Both sides of the threshold

| Pair | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Booked at 150.00, clearance price type | 1.5 (150 or more) |
| Booked at 149.99, clearance price type | 0.5 |
| Booked at 149.99, regular price type | Not multiplied |
| Booked at 220.00, regular price type | 1.5 |

Example (hypothetical): a box amount of 10.00 on designer heels booked at 240.00 becomes 15.00; on flash-sale trainers booked at 60.00, 5.00.
